title: Singapore's Strategic Position on Pax Silica AI Coalition and World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization
what_it_is: Singapore's Strategic Position on Pax Silica AI Coalition and World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization

sections.label: WAICO invitation and ASEAN position
sections.summary: Singapore has an invitation to join WAICO, and there is no ASEAN position on WAICO or Pax Silica.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: [Please refer to "Singapore's Position on Joining WAICO, Implications of Pax Silica Signatory Status and ASEAN Consensus on AI Governance Initiatives", Official Report, 10 September 2026, Vol 96, Issue 37, Written Answers to Questions section.] To Mr Chua's specific questions, Singapore has received an invitation to participate in the World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: There is no Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) position on either WAICO or Pax Silica.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Singapore will therefore consider the invitation alongside our broader engagements with China and other international AI coorperation initiatives.

sections.label: Singapore AI cooperation initiatives
sections.summary: Singapore started a digital pillar for the Forum of Small States and joined the AI for Good Global Commission.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: For example, a few years ago, Singapore initiated a digital pillar for the Forum of Small States, a grouping of 108 United Nations (UN) member states first founded in 1992, which also looks at capacity-building through sharing experiences among its members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Earlier this year, I became a founding member of the AI for Good Global Commission initiated by the International Telecommunications Union.

sections.label: Basis for participating in initiatives
sections.summary: Participation in an initiative depends on its objectives, common interests, complementarity and Singapore's overall interests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Whether we participate in any particular initiative depends on its objectives, the substantive areas of common interest, how it complements our existing engagements and Singapore’s overall interests.

sections.label: Singapore works with ISO
sections.summary: Singapore does seriously work with colleagues in the ISO.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Singapore does seriously work with our colleagues in the ISO.

sections.label: Interest in standards interoperability
sections.summary: Singapore's particular interest is to ensure the interoperability of the standards.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In particular, our interest is to ensure the interoperability of the standards.
